name: incidents
definition_notes: One row per incident.io incident. effective_at = created_at; each update is a new vintage. Attributes: severity, status, service (Affected services), cause, resolved_at.

name: deploys
definition_notes: One row per published GitHub release of the listed repositories. effective_at = published_at. The repo attribute is an entity; entity_alias facts name the service each repository deploys.
